story.intro_aelia.1: Ash? … Ash, it's me, Anii. Can you hear me through the embers?
story.intro_aelia.2: Apophis cursed me. I'm far away, deep in the night… and I'm forgetting. Come for me before I forget you.
story.intro_vesper.1: You again. The Master, the Fowler, says you never really die.
story.intro_vesper.2: I say you die very often. I'm Vesper. I watch the cage. And I keep count.
story.intro_thot.1: Ah… a visitor. Forgive my cracks: I am Thoth, scribe of the gods, or what's left of him.
story.intro_thot.2: The gods call you Bennu, and you don't know why. Your papyrus helps me remember… and I help you remember.
story.intro_brokk.1: Put your parts there. I am Ptah. The craftsmen of Egypt prayed to me before picking up their tools.
story.intro_brokk.2: I don't forge weapons, Bennu: I name them. A well-named weapon remembers what it must do.
story.boss_ammit.1: Ammit devours hearts that are too heavy. Yours is so empty of memories she doesn't know what to do with it. Breathe… and watch where she bites.
story.boss_fenrir.1: Shezmu… Never stand in line with his chains. Once hooked, you end up against his blades. And beware the press when it starts to grind.
story.boss_talos.1: Apophis… The serpent that swallows the sun. Don't stay in front of his jaws, or in the arc of his tail. And when he coils up, get away.
story.boss_oiseleur.1: You saw him… The Fowler. He has known you forever, Ash. Since long before me, maybe.
story.boss_oiseleur.2: The Master wept, afterwards. Don't tell anyone.
story.reach_frost.1: You got past the Underbelly! I felt it: a memory came back to me, just for a moment. Your laugh.
story.reach_olympus.1: The Duat. The world of night, which Ra's barque no longer crosses. Anii is somewhere down there.
story.reach_aviary.1: The Pyramid of Cages. The Master stole it from a forgotten king, and it's my home. Don't touch the cages… Actually, do. All of them. Open them all.
story.deaths_5.1: Five rebirths. Each time you come back with a little more of yourself. I'm archiving it.
story.deaths_15.1: Fifteen. The Master smiles every time you come back. I'm starting to count for you.
story.deaths_30.1: Thirty times you fell, thirty times you came back. I don't know where you find the strength, Ash. But I love you for it.
story.victory_1.1: Ash! A coil broke, I felt it… But I lost something at the same time. A word. "Phoenix"… does that mean anything to you?
story.victory_1.2: Archive: Apophis wrapped ten coils around her. One fewer now. But each one that breaks takes a memory with it.
story.victory_2.1: You remember Greece now? The Master says you were already burning for others there.
story.victory_2.2: And that memory, Anii lost the moment it came back to you. Somewhere, someone is harvesting what she forgets.
story.victory_3.1: A new memory in your eyes: a bird of light above a temple, in Japan. Hō-ō. That was you.
story.victory_3.2: Japan? … I don't remember it anymore. Funny, I was sure I'd been happy there.
story.victory_4.1: Two halves of the sky… Fenghuang. You told me once, I think. Or did I tell you?
story.victory_4.2: Archive: Feng and Huang, one bird for two souls. I'm starting to understand what you two are.
story.victory_5.1: Sit down. This blade was waiting for you. I didn't forge it: I named it. The Dawnblade.
story.victory_5.2: And you remember a huge tree, an eagle, a serpent… and a chatty squirrel. Ratatosk didn't follow you by chance.
story.victory_6.1: Ash, I have to tell you something… I've forgotten Persia. The Simurgh. I'd written it down somewhere, but I don't know where.
story.victory_6.2: Fine. Since it's confession time: your cage was already open when you woke up. That wasn't luck. It was the gods.
story.victory_7.1: All those empty cages up there, under the tip of the pyramid… Phoenix, Hō-ō, Eagle… The Master keeps them like trophies. He always caught you.
story.victory_7.2: And every time, someone came to open it. I think… I think it was me. I don't remember anymore.
story.victory_8.1: In every life, we made each other a promise. Do you remember it? I… don't anymore.
story.victory_8.2: Forbidden archive, finally unlocked: it was Amun, the hidden king, who opened your cage. He has been watching you from the start.
story.victory_9.1: I ran the numbers. Freeing Anii means breaking the last coil… and taking her last memory. She won't know who you are.
story.victory_9.2: And you'll go back anyway. Of course. You firebirds don't know how to do anything else.
story.victory_10.1: Who are you? … I don't know. But when you're here, it's less cold.
story.victory_10.2: She has forgotten everything, Bennu. And still she waits for you. I never understood that. I never managed to keep you apart.
story.victory_10.3: Tell me. Tell me who we were.
story.after_end.1: The Master is gone. Only ashes are left in the cage… and embers that refuse to die. Another escape? For old times' sake?
ending.title: Renewal
ending.1: The last coil broke. Anii was free… and remembered nothing.
ending.2: So Ash told her about their lives, one by one, as she had always done for him.
ending.3: She didn't remember. She kissed him anyway. Their flames mingled, and from the fire the Bennu was born: the sign that everything can be reborn.
ending.4: Then Ash and Anii vanished behind the light, and became ashes again. Over Egypt, the sun rose.
ending.continue: Tap to return to the Cage
weapon.katana.type: Curved sword · Egypt of the pharaohs
weapon.katana.rumor: The blade of kings, curved like an ox's leg. They say this one cut the rope that held Ra's boat.
weapon.twinBlades.type: Twin daggers · iron fallen from the sky
weapon.twinBlades.rumor: Forged from a meteorite, like the dagger found in Tutankhamun's tomb. They say they glow when a star falls.
weapon.staff.rumor: The animal-headed staff the gods hold. Thebes was called Waset, "the city of the sceptre".
weapon.crossbow.rumor: Egypt called its enemies "the Nine Bows". This one is said to have belonged to Neith, goddess of the two arrows.
weapon.disc.rumor: The sun Ra wears on his head. It always returns to whoever throws it, like the sun every morning.
weapon.chain.rumor: Shezmu, god of the wine press… and of punishment. They whisper that its links still tighten.
weapon.dawnblade.rumor: Ptah forged it from a Bennu feather on your 5th victory. They say it warms with every sunrise.

codex.title: Thoth's Archives
codex.intro: Everything Thoth managed to record. An entry opens on the first encounter.
codex.unknownDesc: Thoth has recorded nothing here yet. Meet it to learn more.
codex.enemy.prowler: Tomb robbers from Heliopolis, paid in stolen light by Apophis's servants. They strike fast and in packs, but give up after one good hit.
codex.enemy.gunner: A granite statue woken by Apophis's magic, spitting a shard of light. Its eyes glow before it fires: that's your cue to move.
codex.enemy.brute: A granite giant carved to guard the temples. Slow, but each blow is worth three of yours. Let it swing at nothing.
codex.enemy.stalker: The personal hunter of Apophis's servants. It charges in straight lines, several times in a row. An obstacle between you breaks its momentum.
codex.enemy.wolfbot: Jackals prowling the Nile at night. Fragile alone; in packs, they surround you.
codex.enemy.frostcaster: A priestess of Apophis who learned the cold of moonless nights. She throws three shards of black ice in a fan: slip between them.
codex.enemy.runewarden: He carves cursed hieroglyphs into the ground. The circles explode after a moment: get out in time.
codex.enemy.einherjar: An ancient guard of the pharaoh, brought back by Apophis's curse. His shield blocks everything from the front: hit him from behind.
codex.enemy.hoplite: An embalmed guard, woken by Apophis to hold the halls of the Duat. Slow and sturdy: its wrappings soak up more than you'd think.
codex.enemy.harpy: A ba, the human-headed soul of a dead person, lost in the night. It dives at the living; its dive is fast but always announced.
codex.enemy.oracle: A priest of chaos, crowned with the serpent. Its beam tracks you, then locks: step aside at the last moment.
codex.enemy.minotaur: The keeper of one of the gates of the night. It charges nonstop, blades first; walls and pillars are your friends.
codex.enemy.sparrow: Small steel swallows, born in the forges the Fowler set up inside the pyramid. Harmless alone, exhausting by the dozen.
codex.enemy.crow: The Fowler's eyes: steel vultures that spit five sharp feathers in a fan. Close in fast.
codex.enemy.jailer: It lays snare-nets on the floor, like its master. Never stand still near it.
codex.enemy.herald: A guardian of the pyramid, chained by the Fowler. It defends him against its will. Its beam is slow but devastating, and its stone chest guards its front.
codex.boss.ammit: Crocodile head, lion body, hippopotamus hindquarters: the Devourer swallows the hearts the scales found too heavy. Here, she guards the Underbelly of Heliopolis.
codex.boss.oiseleur: Your eternal enemy, hunter of the gods' birds. Allied with Apophis, he wants to cage you again, forever.
codex.god.ra: The sun of Egypt. Every night his barque crosses the underworld; without the Bennu, he barely rises. His boons burn enemies long after the blow.
codex.god.anubis: Master of embalming, guide of the dead, keeper of the scales where hearts are weighed. He cracks enemy armour, then finishes off the weakest.
codex.god.bastet: The cat goddess of Bubastis, guardian of homes, daughter of Ra. She grants strength, speed and critical hits.

codex.memory.none: No memories yet. Dialogues from the Cage appear here once heard.
story.marks_thot.1: Careful. The Fowler marks some of his servants: armored corners, chevrons, crowns of spikes. I have recorded them. And when a spiked one falls… step away.
story.trials_vesper.1: Seen my trials? The Master says a prisoner in a hurry is a prisoner who makes mistakes. Prove him wrong, if you can.
story.archives_thot.1: I have reopened my archives. Every creature you strike down, I record. Read them: knowledge cuts deeper than a blade.
story.ember_aelia.1: I scattered embers along your path, Ash. If you find one, feed it.
story.ember_aelia.2: But not too much. I need you to come back whole.
story.anvil_brokk.1: If you come across one of my old anvils, help yourself. They still remember my hands.
story.spark_aelia.1: These embers you pick up… they're the Bennu. What's left of him.
story.spark_aelia.2: Or what's left of you. Bennu, Phoenix… same flame, another name. I haven't decided which hypothesis to archive.
codex.weapon.katana: A curved, sickle-shaped blade, the weapon of Egypt's soldiers. Ash found it in Heliopolis, stuck in a broken neon sign. Fast and reliable: perfect for learning the rhythm of combat.
codex.weapon.twinBlades: Two daggers forged from iron fallen from the sky, like that of an ancient pharaoh. For those who like to strike fast and often.
codex.weapon.staff: The sceptre held by the gods, a symbol of power. It strikes from afar and blows up the ground where you aim.
codex.weapon.crossbow: A composite bow of the desert hunters, made of wood and horn. Its charged arrows pierce through enemy ranks.
codex.weapon.disc: A shard of Ra's solar disc, cut by Ptah. In hand, it slices; thrown, it bounces from enemy to enemy and always returns to your hand.
codex.weapon.chain: A chain torn from Shezmu's press. It pulls small enemies in… or pulls you toward big ones.
codex.weapon.dawnblade: Named by Ptah, forged from a Bennu feather. Heavy, slow, but its guard sends every blow back with the strength of dawn.
codex.npc.aelia: Your wife, in every life. She is the one who opened your cage, every time. Apophis cursed her: a prisoner of the night, she loses a memory every day. She speaks to you through the embers.
codex.npc.thot: Scribe of the gods, an ibis with cracked circuits haunting the Cage's terminals. He archives everything, doubts everything, and knows more than he is allowed to say.
codex.npc.vesper: The Fowler's raven. He watches the Cage, mocks you… and sometimes seems to help you more than he should.
codex.npc.brokk: Ptah, god of craftsmen. He doesn't forge weapons: he names them, and they remember what they must do. He improves them for parts found along the way.
codex.npc.oiseleur: Your eternal enemy. He belongs to no mythology: he hunts the birds of the gods to cage them. This time, he has allied with Apophis.
boon.duo_aegis_storm.desc: When your Shield of Sais blocks a hit, lightning strikes the nearest enemy and bounces 3 times: {value} damage.
boon.duo_black_sun.desc: Sting explosions set the enemies hit ablaze: {value} damage per second.
boon.duo_thunder_claws.desc: Your crits stun the enemy ({value} ms).
boon.duo_embalm.desc: An enemy that dies burning heals you {value} HP.
boon.amp_arc.desc: Your chain lightning bounces {value} more times.
boon.amp_winter.desc: Your frost boons add {value} more stack per hit.
boon.amp_plague.desc: Each venom dose deals {value}% more damage.
event.well.title: Ratatosk's Well
event.well.desc: Ratatosk swears this old well grants wishes… for a few shards. Perhaps a god will hear you.
event.shrine.title: Thoth's Shrine
event.shrine.desc: An old Thoth terminal. It can archive your fight, but it feeds on a little of your life.
skill.thoth_ashHeart.desc: Each boss defeated gives you +{value} max HP for the run.
skill.thoth_falcon.desc: Your lunges and whirlwinds deal +{value}% damage.
skill.thoth_chisel.desc: Each run starts with a free Engraving of Ptah.
skill.thoth_firstFavor.desc: The first boon of each run is at least rare.
skill.thoth_eye.desc: The gods offer you 4 boons instead of 3.
skill.thoth_rebirth.desc: {value} time(s) per run, a lethal blow brings you back with 40% of your HP.
depart.title: Choose your weapon
depart.intro: The weapon you take on this escape. Greyed-out weapons are unlocked at Ptah's.
merchant.title: Ratatosk's Trading Post
merchant.name: Ratatosk
merchant.greet.1: Shards? I've got just what you need, friend!
merchant.greet.2: I run between the worlds. News travels fast… so do prices.
merchant.greet.3: The Master of the pyramid hates me trading with you. All the more reason!
merchant.greet.4: Come closer, come closer! Everything's guaranteed… until the next room.
merchant.greet.5: Still alive? Just like under the World Tree! You don't remember? I do.
bark.brokk.1: Don't touch the anvil. It bites.
bark.brokk.2: My hammer's name is Gerald. Don't ask.
bark.brokk.3: I've been shaping things since the world's first morning. You've been dying for three days. Respect your elders.
bark.brokk.4: Parts, parts… You think metal grows on trees?
bark.brokk.5: Come back with a broken weapon, I'll remake it. Come back broken, go see Anii.
bark.brokk.6: I've worked for Ra. He never says thank you either.
bark.thot.1: Rebirth #{deaths} archived. I'm running out of space.
bark.thot.2: Statistically, you should be discouraged. Statistically.
bark.thot.3: I don't judge. I archive. It's worse.
bark.thot.4: Update in progress… Oh no. That's just you breathing loudly.
bark.thot.5: Free advice: avoid dying. Paid advice is more detailed.
bark.thot.6: Error 404: motivation not found. Ah, there it is. Under your cloak.
bark.vesper.1: Caw. That's what a normal raven would say. I'd rather judge you.
bark.vesper.2: The Master says you're stubborn. I say you're slow.
bark.vesper.3: The door again? It leads to the same place as last time, you know.
bark.vesper.4: I'm not helping you. I'm optimizing your suffering. Big difference.
bark.vesper.5: If you win, I saw nothing. If you lose, I filmed everything.
bark.aelia.1: Have you eaten? Oh, right… you're made of ashes.
bark.aelia.2: If you meet the Fowler, tell him his decor is awful.
bark.aelia.3: I'm waiting for you. But don't dawdle: every night I forget a little more.
bark.aelia.4: Take care of yourself. Well… of what's left.
bark.aelia.5: Don't let Ptah tell you about Gerard. Too late?
codex.enemy.mender: An embalmer who stitches the wounded back together with his wrappings. A green ring announces each heal: take him out first.
codex.enemy.warder: He hands out protective amulets to his allies. A pale blue circle surrounds those he protects: hit them until it breaks, or go straight for him.
codex.enemy.leaper: A giant locust, as in the days of the plagues of Egypt. The red circle shows where it will land: get out, and hit it while it gets up.
codex.enemy.diffuser: A bronze scarab spitting eight darts at once, in every direction. Slip between two lines of fire.
boss.variantSub: A deadlier version… and a more generous one
challenge.dark.sub: The enemies see in the dark. You, a little.
challenge.champion.sub: A single opponent… but what an opponent
god.ra.quote.1: You again, Bennu? Good. The sun loves stubborn people.
god.ra.quote.2: Burn them. I'll handle the lighting.
god.ra.quote.3: Without you, I don't rise anymore. So hurry up a little.
god.ra.quote.4: Don't stare at my boons too long, you'll hurt your eyes.
god.anubis.quote.1: I weigh hearts. Yours is… light. Surprising.
god.anubis.quote.2: First I crack the armour. Then Thoth writes down the result.
god.anubis.quote.3: You die often, Bennu. I opened a file in your name.
god.anubis.quote.4: The weighing is quick. Yours, and theirs.
god.bastet.quote.1: Faster. Cats never run. They arrive.
god.bastet.quote.2: Claw first, think later. Always works.
god.bastet.quote.3: My cats guarded the granaries of Egypt. I'll guard you too.
god.bastet.quote.4: If you find a ball of yarn, it's mine.
story.thot_glitch.1: I… I… Sorry. I stutter when I recalculate your odds of survival. It happens a lot.
story.vesper_rumor.1: Ratatosk has been selling the same whetstone for three hundred years. Nobody ever noticed. Don't tell him I told you.
story.vesper_arena.1: Seen the champion's arena? I'm the one selling tickets. You didn't pay, by the way.
story.thot_variants.1: Archive: the guardians learn from their defeats. Sometimes they'll come back stronger. So will you, I hope.
story.brokk_gerald.1: Gerard and I shaped the first man. Well… the first toe. But a fine toe.
story.brokk_gerald.2: Archived: Ptah exaggerates. Again. Reference no. 4,812.
story.vesper_sleep.1: The Master never sleeps. I do. Between two and three in the morning. Just saying. Not saying anything.
story.aelia_memory.1: This morning I forgot your face. Then I saw an ember dance, and it came back.
story.aelia_memory.2: Don't worry. I'll remember you. I promised myself.
story.brokk_marks.1: The Fowler's beasts wear marks now? Shoddy work. A mark should mean something. Those only say fear.
tutorial.move.touch: Put your thumb on the left of the screen and slide to move.
tutorial.move.keys: Move with WASD (or ZQSD) or the arrow keys.
tutorial.attack.touch: Tap the big orange button to attack. Chain hits for a combo!
tutorial.attack.keys: Attack with J or left click. Chain hits for a combo!
tutorial.attack.pad: Attack with □ / X. Chain hits for a combo!
tutorial.dash.touch: The blue ›› button: a quick dodge. Nothing can hit you mid-dash.
tutorial.dash.keys: Dodge with Space or Shift. Nothing can hit you mid-dash.
tutorial.dash.pad: Dodge with ✕ / A. Nothing can hit you mid-dash.
tutorial.power.touch: The → button: power attack, slower but stronger.
tutorial.power.keys: K or right click: power attack, slower but stronger.
tutorial.power.pad: △ / Y: power attack, slower but stronger.
tutorial.super.touch: Your gauge is full! Tap the star to unleash your Super.
tutorial.super.keys: Your gauge is full! Press E to unleash your Super.
tutorial.super.pad: Your gauge is full! Press ○ / B to unleash your Super.
tutorial.doors: Room cleared! Walk to a door: its symbol shows your next reward.
trophy.title: Trophies
trophy.allWeapons.desc: Win with each of the {goal} weapons.
trophy.guardians.desc: Beat all {goal} bosses at least once.
trophy.pantheon.desc: Accept a boon from each of the {goal} gods.
trophy.swift.desc: Win a run in under {goal} minutes.
trophy.pressure.desc: Win with {goal} or more points on the scales of Ma'at.
trophy.inferno.desc: Win with {goal} or more points on the scales of Ma'at.
trophy.thothMaster.desc: Max out all {goal} of Thoth's skills.
god.sobek.title: Crocodile of the Nile — water
god.khonsou.title: The wandering moon — ice
god.seth.title: Master of storms — lightning
god.serket.title: The scorpion goddess — poison
god.isis.title: The great sorceress — healing
god.neith.title: Lady of Sais — the shield
god.sobek.quote.1: The Nile carries everything away. Your enemies too, if you ask nicely.
god.sobek.quote.2: Soak them first. Set will handle the rest. He loves that.
god.sobek.quote.3: A crocodile doesn't run. It waits for the prey to slip.
god.sobek.quote.4: You're made of fire, Bennu? Stay away from my waters, then.
god.khonsou.quote.1: The night has been long since you vanished. And cold. Very cold.
god.khonsou.quote.2: Freeze them, and take your time. They have none left.
god.khonsou.quote.3: I cross the sky every night. Tonight, I cross your enemies.
god.khonsou.quote.4: A tip: dress warmly. Oh, you're made of fire. Never mind.
god.seth.quote.1: Every night I push back the serpent. Tonight, your turn to strike.
god.seth.quote.2: One bolt, two bolts… I stopped counting, and so will you.
god.seth.quote.3: They call me chaotic. Let me show you well-aimed chaos.
god.seth.quote.4: If Sobek soaked them, tell me. I don't want to miss it.
god.serket.quote.1: One sting is nothing. Ten stings is a work of art.
god.serket.quote.2: Venom is patient. Be patient too.
god.serket.quote.3: I usually heal stings. Today, I hand them out.
god.serket.quote.4: Don't shake my hand, Bennu. Trust me.
god.isis.quote.1: I know Apophis's magic. I'll help you undo it, Bennu.
god.isis.quote.2: I once put a god back together. You'll be easy.
god.isis.quote.3: Save your strength. Anii needs you to come back whole.
god.isis.quote.4: Every wound closes. Even the ones no one sees.
god.neith.quote.1: A shield first, an arrow next. That's how you survive.
god.neith.quote.2: I wove the world. I can weave a wall around you.
god.neith.quote.3: Let them strike. My shield likes the noise.
god.neith.quote.4: They painted me with arrows. Trust me, the shield sees more use.
codex.god.sobek: The crocodile god of the Nile, worshipped in the Faiyum. His water slows enemies, makes them conduct lightning and freeze faster.
codex.god.khonsou: The moon, whose name means "the traveller". Nothing is colder than a desert night: his cold slows, then freezes solid.
codex.god.seth: God of storms and the desert. Standing at the prow of Ra's barque, he drives back Apophis every night. His lightning leaps from enemy to enemy.
codex.god.serket: The scorpion goddess, who heals stings and helps bind Apophis. Her venom builds up hit after hit, and her stingers make enemies explode.
codex.god.isis: The great magician. She put Osiris back together and tricked Ra into revealing his secret name: no one knows magic better, even Apophis's. She heals.
codex.god.neith: The lady of Sais, goddess of war and weaving, with her shield and crossed arrows. She blocks blows and destroys projectiles.
boon.sobek_attack.desc: Your attack soaks the enemy: {value}% slower for 3 s. Soaked, it takes more lightning and freezes faster.
boon.sobek_power.desc: Your power attack soaks the enemy: {value}% slower for 4 s.
boon.sobek_dash.desc: Your dash sends a wave that pushes nearby enemies back: {value} damage.
boon.khonsou_attack.desc: Your attack adds {value} frost. Frost slows; at 5, the enemy freezes in place.
boon.khonsou_power.desc: Your power attack adds {value} frost. At 5, the enemy freezes in place.
boon.khonsou_dash.desc: Your dash adds {value} frost to nearby enemies.
boon.khonsou_heart.desc: +{value}% damage against chilled or frozen enemies.
boon.seth_attack.desc: Your attack fires a bolt that bounces to 2 nearby enemies: {value} damage.
boon.seth_power.desc: Your power attack calls lightning on each enemy hit: {value} damage around.
boon.seth_dash.desc: Your dash stuns nearby enemies for {value} ms.
boon.seth_riposte.desc: When you're hit, lightning strikes the nearest enemy: {value} damage.
boon.serket_attack.desc: Your attack adds {value} venom dose(s) (2 damage per second each, up to 8 doses).
boon.serket_power.desc: Your power attack adds {value} venom doses.
boon.serket_dash.desc: Your dash stings nearby enemies: they explode when they die ({value} damage).
boon.anubis_break.desc: Your attack cracks armor: the enemy takes +{value}% damage for 4 s.
boon.bastet_lives.desc: +{value} max HP, and you heal that much.
boon.isis_soul.desc: Each enemy defeated heals you {value} HP.
boon.isis_power.desc: Your power attack heals you {value} HP per enemy hit.
boon.isis_dash.desc: Your dash gives you a {value} HP shield. Isis took the form of a kite to protect her own.
boon.isis_attack.desc: Your attack gives you a {value} HP shield (refreshed on each hit, does not stack).
boon.isis_dew.desc: Each cleared room heals you {value} HP.
boon.isis_last.desc: Once per run, a lethal blow leaves you alive with {value} HP.
boon.neith_aegis.desc: In each room, the first hit you take is blocked ({value} hit(s)).
boon.neith_attack.desc: Your attack weakens: the enemy deals {value}% less damage for 4 s.
boon.neith_power.desc: Your power attack grants a {value} HP shield.
boon.neith_dash.desc: Your dash destroys enemy projectiles around you (radius {value}).
boon.anubis_weigh.desc: Your attack and power attack execute enemies (not bosses) below {value}% health.
story.v3_awaken.1: Ash… This morning, I searched for your name. It took me a long time.
story.v3_awaken.2: It's Apophis's curse: every day it takes a memory from me. But you're getting some back. I can feel it.
story.v3_ratatosk.1: Have you seen the squirrel who keeps shop between worlds? Ratatosk. He says he followed you from a giant tree, up North.
story.v3_ratatosk.2: Archive: there, he carried messages between an eagle and a serpent. You seem to half-know him. He knows you completely.
story.v3_ptah.1: These gods lending you their powers, Bennu… they don't do it out of charity. They need you to succeed.
story.v3_ptah.2: Archive: Ptah is right, for once. But he won't tell you why. Neither will I. Not yet.
boss.shezmu.title: Executioner of the Midnight Nile
boss.shezmu.defeated: Shezmu falls… the press goes silent.
codex.boss.shezmu: The lion-headed executioner of wicked souls. In his press he crushes the memories torn from Anii, to make wine for Apophis. His chains drag his victims toward his blades.
boss.apophis.title: The Serpent of Isfet
codex.boss.apophis: The great serpent of chaos. Every night he attacks Ra's barque. He is the one who cursed Anii: ten coils wrapped around her memories. Each victory breaks one.
